title: Skyscanner Hotels Scraper
description: Collect hotel listing data from a Skyscanner search URL or destination.

url.title: Skyscanner search URL
url.description: A public Skyscanner hotel search URL. If both url and location are provided, url takes priority.

location.title: Location
location.description: A city or destination name, a numeric Skyscanner entity ID, or a Skyscanner destination URL. Used when url is empty.

checkin.title: Check-in
checkin.description: Check-in date in YYYY-MM-DD format. A value here overrides the date in the search URL.

checkout.title: Check-out
checkout.description: Check-out date in YYYY-MM-DD format. A value here overrides the date in the search URL.

market.title: Market
market.description: Two-letter market code used for pricing and availability, for example US or UK.

locale.title: Locale
locale.description: Locale used for labels and translated listing content.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Three-letter currency code used for prices.

sortBy.title: Sort listings
sortBy.description: Order in which hotels are returned.

results_wanted.title: Maximum hotels
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of unique hotel listings saved across the run.

max_pages.title: Maximum pages
max_pages.description: Maximum listing pages requested. Each page contains up to 35 hotels.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Use Apify Proxy or your own proxy URLs for reliable production runs.
